theme: Mid-summer at its fullest - Mughal gardens in bloom, deep-green meadows, the Dal glass at dawn, a day trip up to Sonamarg's glaciers to escape the plains' heat
season: Mid-summer (17 July 2026). The Amarnath Yatra is on (3 Jul - 28 Aug), so the Srinagar-Pahalgam and Srinagar-Sonamarg roads run heavy and hotels fill fast - book 3-4 weeks ahead and travel within the valley in daylight. Srinagar is cool at dawn and warm by day while the plains sit above 40C; gardens are at peak bloom, the meadows are deep green, the Dal is glass at first light. Fast-changing weather with sunny mornings, cool evenings and brief afternoon showers.
campaign_name: Kashmir Mid-July gardens at full bloom [INR] - 17 Jul 2026
subject: Kashmir's gardens are at their fullest this week
